_comment: Path-class map for the Task Tracker demo. This file decides M2 (sensitive surface).
Without it M2 can NEVER fire and every change scans as 'fired: none' at HIGH confidence,
so scan.py k1 refuses to run unless it is present or --no-map is passed explicitly.
Classes are tuned to THIS app's real layout: there is no Security/ directory — all
authentication, authorization, CORS and rate-limit policy lives in Program.cs, which is
why the composition root is classed as auth.
